answer: The R21/Matrix-M vaccine reached 77% effectiveness in Phase 2 clinical trials [2]. In Phase 3 trials, 12-month vaccine efficacy was 75% at seasonal sites [2]. At standard sites, it was 68% [2]. Efficacy against multiple clinical malaria episodes was 75% at seasonal sites [2]. At standard sites, it was 67% [2]. The vaccine offered up to 77% protection against the malaria parasite in clinical trials [2].
